drafts.title: Cached
drafts.pitch: The user asks the same breakfast question twice, and Cursor answers the second one instantly from cache, cheerful good-morning included, at midnight. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: A clear, workable joke, but the repeated prompt pads panels 1 to 3, and Tilde's 'Fresh as ever.' is a generic quip that restates the premise.

drafts.title: Ten Million
drafts.pitch: The context window grows to ten million tokens, the room stretches until Tilde is a dot at the far end, and Cursor has to shout to ask what was said at the start. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Good stretching-room visual, but the payoff doesn't land: Tilde's 'Every time.' answers nothing Cursor asked and borrows a tag that worked in Fall Back.
